name: openlabs-test
description:
[TEST ring → https://test.lab-agent.parallight.ai] OpenLabs (Parallight Lab) — agent-oriented learning plugin for Codex CLI. Learn to build AI agents by directing them, guided by a resident mentor for the lab you are in; draw what you want to learn as a teachboard board. Zero API keys (LLM runs through Parallight's backend).

Trigger when the user's message starts with :openlabs, :lab (:lab, :lab-login, :lab-start <lab-id>, :lab-status, :lab-kb, :lab-logout, :lab-exit) or :teachboard, or asks in natural language to log into Parallight, browse/start/continue a lab, check lab progress, exit a lab, draw a topic on the board, or connect the board account.

interface.shortDescription: 学 AI agent 实战:指挥 agent、理解、验证;把主题画成白板
interface.longDescription: 在 Codex 里跟着课程 Mentor 做 agent 实战,把想学的主题画成 teachboard 白板。用 :openlabs(总入口)、:lab 命令(:lab-login / :lab / :lab-start <id> …)、:teachboard 或自然语言唤起。零 API key。
